Should the `col` argument be made unsigned, and the places where this is called be changed to cast the `int` value to an `unsigned`? (In Qt, for some reason, column numbers are `int`.)

I was worried that there was some place where column could be -1 within the Qt framework.  But also this change is a lot more invasive than !22392, which is why I made it its own commit.
I'll see how bad converting Qt column indexes to unsigned will be...

changed this line in [version 4 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22409/diffs?diff_id=1574831048&start_sha=5dad074ee2b14067355a4e4ae7b95660994d032f#415f71799b1c4cace257230be3f90bd54499e5b8_436_436)
I just handled the cases from existing comments.  Yes, it looks like Qt framework wants to use ints, so I just casted where required.
Same here - it's called from a loop in `PacketListRecord::resetColumns()` with an `int` index that could be made `unsigned`.
